'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 John Veasey DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The poison I picked
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
